headline: Champagne and Bullets belongs on the Mount Rushmore of bad movies
summary: Review highlights 'Champagne and Bullets' as an irresistible 'so bad they're good' film. It joins cult classics like 'The Room' and 'Troll 2' in its unique appeal. The movie's ambition far outstrips its ability, creating a fascinating cinematic curiosity.

headline: Apple is banking on privacy to set its smart glasses apart
summary: Apple reportedly plans to unveil smart glasses at WWDC next June, aiming for a late 2027 launch. Privacy features and messaging are a key focus, potentially contributing to development delays. The company hopes strong privacy will differentiate its smart glasses from competitors, particularly Meta.

headline: The US is charging an American citizen for wiping his phone at the border
summary: A US citizen, Sam Tunick, is being charged for allegedly wiping his phone with a 'duress password' at Atlanta airport. Federal agents detained Tunick and attempted to seize his phone, questioning him about child exploitation images. Tunick's lawyers have filed a motion to dismiss the charges against him.

headline: Carrie is just trying to make a friend in the new trailer
summary: Mike Flanagan's new adaptation of Stephen King's 'Carrie' is set to premiere on Amazon Prime on October 7th. A new trailer, released at Comic-Con 2026, showcases the updated take on the classic story. The adaptation is expected to hit familiar notes while bringing a modern sensibility to the horror tale.

headline: House of the Dragon Just Gave a Major Character the Send-Off They Bitterly Deserved
summary: House of the Dragon's Season 3, Episode 6 began with the death of a major character. The character's demise was faithful to George R.R. Martin's 'Fire & Blood' source material. The article suggests the send-off was deserved, with little sympathy for the departed character.

headline: House of the Dragon Season 3, Episode 6 Recap and Review
summary: This latest episode marks the three-quarter point of 'House of the Dragon' Season 3. The season is being hailed as the best in the show's history for its nuanced and complex narrative. Critics praise its depth, noting it avoids artificial complications for the sake of drama.

headline: Marvel Reveals First Clip of Sadie Sink in Spider-Man: Brand New Day, But Fans Aren't Sure What She's Trying to Say in It
summary: Marvel released a very short clip featuring Sadie Sink in the upcoming 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day'. Fans are attempting to decipher what Sink's mystery character is saying in the brief footage. The teaser has left many viewers speculating about her role and dialogue.

headline: Preorders Are Live for Hasbro’s The Legend of Zelda Figures – Here’s Where You Can Grab Them
summary: Hasbro's new 'The Legend of Zelda' figures are now available for preorder. The collection includes iconic characters Link, Zelda, and Ganondorf. Figures are slated for release on May 1st next year, with details on where to buy them provided.

headline: Firefighters battle wildfire as tens of thousands evacuated near Bordeaux
summary: Firefighters are actively battling widespread wildfires near Bordeaux, France. Over 330,000 people have been evacuated from fire-affected regions across France and Spain. The intense blazes continue to pose a significant threat, prompting massive displacement efforts.

headline: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation
summary: Abdul Ballout, the suspect in a Berlin Pride attack, was shot and killed by police. The incident occurred in a western borough of Berlin during a police operation. Authorities reported that Ballout rushed at officers wielding a knife.

headline: Badenoch says PM must rule out tax rises to fund social care reform
summary: Kemi Badenoch has urged the Prime Minister to explicitly rule out tax increases for social care reform. In a letter, the Conservative leader offered to collaborate on adult social care initiatives. Badenoch emphasizes that funding reform should not come at the expense of higher taxes.

headline: PM pledges continued support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit
summary: The Prime Minister has reaffirmed the UK's unwavering support for Ukraine. This commitment comes in anticipation of Ukrainian President Zelensky's upcoming visit. Zelensky's visit will mark his first international engagement with Andy Burnham since he took office.
